description: This Java source file defines the SearchActor class, an Akka actor responsible for handling various ThingSearchCommands such as CountThings, QueryThings, and StreamThings. It manages parsing commands into queries, executing searches against a persistence layer, and returning results, including handling timers and error recovery.

classes.name: SearchActor
classes.description: An Akka actor that handles ThingSearchCommands, manages query parsing, executes searches, and returns results, including timers and error handling.

methods.name: props
methods.description: Creates Props configuration for the SearchActor with specified query parser and persistence layer.

methods.name: createReceive
methods.description: Defines message handling for different command types such as CountThings, QueryThings, StreamThings, etc.

methods.name: namespaceReport
methods.description: Handles SudoRetrieveNamespaceReport commands, generating namespace count reports.

methods.name: count
methods.description: Processes CountThings commands, executing count queries.

methods.name: sudoCount
methods.description: Processes SudoCountThings commands, executing sudo count queries.

methods.name: executeCount
methods.description: Executes count commands, managing timers, query parsing, and search execution.

methods.name: stream
methods.description: Handles StreamThings commands, executing streaming search queries.

methods.name: query
methods.description: Processes QueryThings commands, executing search queries and returning results.

methods.name: stopTimerAndHandleError
methods.description: Stops timers and handles errors during stream or query processing.

methods.name: processSearchPersistenceResult
methods.description: Logs and processes results from search persistence layer.

methods.name: asDittoRuntimeException
methods.description: Converts Throwable errors into DittoRuntimeException, adding headers and logging.

methods.name: toQueryThingsResponse
methods.description: Converts search results into QueryThingsResponse objects, including handling empty results.

methods.name: startNewTimer
methods.description: Starts a new timer for metrics collection with specific tags.

methods.name: createQuerySource
methods.description: Creates a source from a query parser function and command, handling exceptions.

methods.name: stopTimer
methods.description: Stops a timer, catching and ignoring IllegalStateException.
